CustomField.description: Selects which duplicate/matching rule(s) the conversion Setup Flow uses to find an existing Account to update before creating a new one. Multi-select; evaluated by the Account upsert convert Flow. Works with Update Most Confident (Account) when several matches are returned.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose the matching/duplicate rules used to find an existing Account before a new one is created on conversion. Combine with Update Most Confident (Account) to control which match wins.
CustomField.label: Account Matching Rules
